title: Tall white children's play saucer

tellings.quote: a saucer that you might have for your children to take out to the play area, which I also saw. It's not meant to go faster than light.

plain: Among the craft of the Tall Whites, the tall, pale beings he says lived in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, in the 1960s, Charles Hall says there was a small saucer made for children, "a saucer that you might have for your children to take out to the play area." Hall, who says he spent three years near these beings while stationed in the area, tells Michels he saw it himself and that "it's not meant to go faster than light," unlike their larger ships.
